page.overview:
What is Explorers?

The Explorers are a mysterious organization that are the sworn enemies of the Rising Volt Tacklers, appearing as the main antagonists in . Their goals and motivations seem to revolve around the mysterious pendant and an ancient Poké Ball currently owned by Liko and Roy respectively, which they are set on stealing and even kidnapping to unlock their secrets.

Originally, the Explorers were founded by Lucius, Rystal, and Gibeon 100 years ago.

As of the end of , Spinel has now taken over the organisation following Gibeon's demise. However In "Stellar Finale", Cervantis takes over as leader of the Explorers and retakes his position as the director of Exceed after Spinel was arrested.

100 years in the past, Lucius decided to team up with Gibeon and Rystal to search for the paradise, Laqua. They soon named their group the Explorers and set forth to search for the paradise in question.
